id: \bDid you hear? Someone broke into the Poké Ball Factory.
en: \bDid you hear? Someone broke into the Poké Ball Factory.
it: \bHai sentito? Qualcuno si è introdotto nella Fabbrica Poké Ball.

id: \bSawyer: You beat the gym already? Man you're good. I've trained up a little too. Let me show you.
en: \bSawyer: You beat the gym already? Man you're good. I've trained up a little too. Let me show you.
it: \bSawyer: Hai già battuto la Palestra? Accidenti se sei bravo. Anch'io mi sono allenato un po'. Lascia che te lo dimostri.

id: \bI've learned so much in these battles we've had. I'm going to head to Coumarine City and try the gym there. Next time I see you I hope to be stronger.
en: \bI've learned so much in these battles we've had. I'm going to head to Coumarine City and try the gym there. Next time I see you I hope to be stronger.
it: \bHo imparato tantissimo nelle lotte che abbiamo fatto. Andrò a Temperopoli a tentare la Palestra di lì. Spero di essere più forte la prossima volta che ci vediamo.

id: \rWe would like to thank you for your help with the thieves. Please accept this gift.
en: \rWe would like to thank you for your help with the thieves. Please accept this gift.
it: \rVorremmo ringraziarti per il tuo aiuto con i ladri. Accetta questo regalo.

id: \rWe thank you for your help with the thieves. However, this area is off limits.
en: \rWe thank you for your help with the thieves.  However, this area is off limits.
it: \rTi ringraziamo per il tuo aiuto con i ladri.  Tuttavia, quest'area è off-limits.

id: \bLet me share my joy with you.
en: \bLet me share my joy with you.
it: \bLascia che condivida con te la mia gioia.

id: \bI have a bunch of them. Don't worry about it.
en: \bI have a bunch of them. Don't worry about it.
it: \bNe ho un sacco. Non preoccuparti.

id: \bI wonder what they plan to do now that they broke in.
en: \bI wonder what they plan to do now that they broke in.
it: \bMi chiedo cosa abbiano intenzione di fare ora che si sono introdotti lì.

id: \bSawyer: I'm working up the nerve to battle this gym. Wish me luck.
en: \bSawyer: I'm working up the nerve to battle this gym. Wish me luck.
it: \bSawyer: Sto trovando il coraggio di sfidare questa Palestra. Augurami buona fortuna.

id: \bSawyer: I can't believe I lost. How am I going to get good enough to try again?
en: \bSawyer: I can't believe I lost. How am I going to get good enough to try again?
it: \bSawyer: Non posso credere di aver perso. Come farò a diventare abbastanza bravo da riprovarci?

id: \bI'm sorry. You need to get into the gym, don't you. That must mean you're a Trainer. How many badges to you have?
en: \bI'm sorry. You need to get into the gym, don't you. That must mean you're a Trainer. How many badges to you have?
it: \bScusa. Devi entrare in Palestra, vero? Allora vuol dire che sei un Allenatore. Quante Medaglie hai?

id: \bYou already have that many!? You have to battle with me then. I only have one badge, but I think I'll be a good challenge.
en: \bYou already have that many!? You have to battle with me then. I only have one badge, but I think I'll be a good challenge.
it: \bNe hai già così tante!? Allora devi lottare con me. Io ho solo una Medaglia, ma credo di poter essere una bella sfida.

id: \bThat was impressive. I see now what I need to do to get better. I'm going to go practice. Thanks for your help.
en: \bThat was impressive. I see now what I need to do to get better. I'm going to go practice. Thanks for your help.
it: \bÈ stato impressionante. Ora capisco cosa devo fare per migliorare. Vado ad allenarmi. Grazie per l'aiuto.

en: \rThe Fan Club is so nice. They let me visit all the time even though I'm not a member.
it: \rIl Fan Club è così gentile. Mi lasciano venire a trovarli sempre, anche se non sono socia.

en: Scarf Shop.\nWe have them!

en: \rValerie is so cool. She offered to teach me to battle.
it: \rValerie è fantastica. Si è offerta di insegnarmi a lottare.
